q: What are the CBAM benchmark values for steel, cement, aluminium and fertilisers?
title: CBAM benchmark values by product
short: The CBAM benchmark sets the free allocation deducted per tonne. For default-value imports, rebar and wire rod on the blast furnace route use 1.364 t CO2e per tonne, grey clinker 0.666, unwrought primary aluminium 1.423, anhydrous ammonia 1.522 and hydrogen 5.089.
audience: Exporters and importers estimating the free allocation adjustment

sections.h: Default CBAM benchmarks (Column B), t CO2e per tonne
ul: CN 7213 and 7214 20 00 bars and rods, BF/BOF route: 1.364; DRI/EAF route: 0.475
CN 7208 hot-rolled flat, BF/BOF route: 1.370; DRI/EAF route: 0.481
CN 7601 unwrought aluminium, primary route: 1.423; unwrought alloys, secondary route: 0.091

p: The India table in the default values annex flags the route that sets the benchmark. For most Indian carbon steel it is the blast furnace and basic oxygen furnace route, marked (C).
Column A applies to a production process when actual data are used and precursors are counted separately. Column B is the default benchmark that already includes precursors, used with default values.

senseible: Senseible reads coal, coke, gas, electricity and freight invoices into a dated, fingerprinted record per site, so an actual figure you send an EU buyer can be traced back to the documents behind it. It does not file CBAM declarations.
